levers.label: Cloning a long-only perfect-hindsight oracle
levers.hypothesis: A network that imitates an oracle's perfect entries/exits learns the MECHANISM of a swing, not the price of any single coin.
levers.expects: Buy/sell signals that generalize across the 14 pooled cryptos.

levers.label: 60-day trend filter
levers.source: Consistency law (operator, 2026-08-19) — a direct survival lever in bear years
levers.hypothesis: Entering only in a 60d+ uptrend keeps the book flat in broad bear markets (2018, 2022), the consistency law's open problem.
levers.expects: Raise the WORST year; less loss in bear years.

levers.label: Sample-uniqueness weighting
levers.source: Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial ML (ch. 4)
levers.hypothesis: Windows overlap heavily (one label per candle); weighting each swing equally (1/leg-duration) avoids overfitting the redundant long legs.
levers.expects: Less overfitting; higher worst year without hurting the sealed 2026 readout.

levers.label: Purged validation + embargo
levers.source: Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial ML (ch. 7)
levers.hypothesis: The oracle labels are computed over the WHOLE series, so train bars next to the cut 'see' the future through the pivots; purging + embargoing them gives an honest validation to select on.
levers.expects: Close the gap between internal validation and the sealed 2026 readout.

levers.label: Network committee (bagging)
levers.source: Lopez de Prado (bagging in finance); general ML variance reduction
levers.hypothesis: Averaging N networks with different seeds cuts VARIANCE — the direct enemy of year-to-year consistency.
levers.expects: More stable years; less dependence on a single network's luck.

score_metric: worst calendar-year return + 0.10*CAGR (each year 2018..2025 an independent account; 2026 sealed)
reproducible_bar_note: Median research score of the four P35 seeds at width 192, all four improving on the old champion. The bar a future candidate must beat is what THIS recipe reproducibly does, not what its luckiest draw did once.

superseded_2026-08-29.note: the pre-adoption shipping config, preserved verbatim

adoption.seed_rule: lower-middle of the four P35 seeds
adoption.note: First candidate to cross the operator's +30% forward target. Research 2025 is -1.66% - the all-years-green ideal is not met in research space and is recorded, not hidden. Drawdown 22.5% vs 19.0%: gain per drawdown point is disproportionate (BALANCE criterion).

adoption_fear_veto.why: the only lever measured to improve the HELD-OUT median (-0.8% -> +2.0%, A65); research score +0.1095 -> +0.1100 with every year still green and 2018/2019/2020 each better; threshold is the index's own published Extreme Fear boundary, never fitted to our data

adoption_realism.why: 2021 audit found $45M orders in single 15m candles at a flat 15 bps - internally consistent, economically unreal. Levers fixed by operator instruction and mechanics before the table was run.
adoption_realism.note: 2026 sealed: +32.24% -> +33.86% with drawdown 22.5% -> 21.3% (the cap barely binds at $100k and prunes oversized entries in thin bars). 2025 turns green (+0.20%): the red year was CAUSED by oversized orders. All nine years positive under realism. Second sealed read of the day, both on operator-fixed configurations, neither selected from a menu.
